svg.title: Table 3: User study
svg.desc: User-study scores for the five main methods over all 42 cases (Total). Entries report the original means with their associated errors; GPT-5.6-Sol is a fixed reference at 50. Bold marks the largest mean (best result) for each dimension. Cell backgrounds encode the mean relative to the reference: white at 50, increasingly green above 50, and increasingly red below 50. Text2Sim: Task faithfulness 61.11 ± 2.59, Physical plausibility 62.10 ± 2.59, Visual quality 59.92 ± 3.01, Overall preference 61.41 ± 3.11; GPT-5.6-Sol: Task faithfulness 50 (anchor), Physical plausibility 50 (anchor), Visual quality 50 (anchor), Overall preference 50 (anchor); Qwen-3.8-Max: Task faithfulness 48.11 ± 3.07, Physical plausibility 47.82 ± 3.41, Visual quality 45.34 ± 3.30, Overall preference 48.02 ± 3.57; Claude-Opus-5: Task faithfulness 53.97 ± 2.97, Physical plausibility 52.98 ± 3.11, Visual quality 51.98 ± 3.19, Overall preference 54.17 ± 3.41; Code2Worlds: Task faithfulness 49.17 ± 2.76, Physical plausibility 44.74 ± 3.47, Visual quality 54.56 ± 3.10, Overall preference 48.31 ± 3.37
